review_type: final internal consistency sweep; no new research
method: Read the materiality fields in all 90 capsules and the materiality plus controlling/source-audit correction sections in their dossiers. Cross-checked amount/period/tax labels and explicit comparison language, then checked E0/E1 absence language against firm E2/G2 statements elsewhere in each packet.

non_error_observations.observation: The packet gives the exact calculation as $666.45m and uses approximately $666m/$666.5m/about $667m in different fields. This was treated as disclosed rounding, not a factual contradiction.
Earlier dossier text was treated as superseded only where a later controlling/source-audit correction expressly states that it governs or withdraws the earlier treatment.

limitations: This was a consistency-only review. Sources were not reopened and underlying financial or AI claims were not independently revalidated.
The review tested internal amount, date/period, tax-basis and evidence-stage consistency; it did not reassess scoring, valuation, ranking or investment conclusions.
E-stage review checks whether an asserted absence conflicts with firm deployment language in the same packet. It does not decide whether the cited evidence substantively merits the assigned stage.
Rounded figures were not classified as errors when an exact calculation in the same packet reconciled the difference.
No contradiction was recorded for stale earlier language when an explicit controlling correction clearly superseded or withdrew it.

resolved_errors.concrete_error: The dossier compares a $0.524bn annual pre-tax illustrative expense benefit with a $3.38bn annual after-tax earnings hurdle and calls it well below the hurdle. No tax conversion or explicit NOT_COMPARABLE treatment is supplied. The capsule correctly labels the hurdle after tax but does not cure the dossier comparison.
resolved_errors.required_resolution: Either convert the illustrative benefit to after tax using an explicitly labeled tax assumption, or withdraw the above/below comparison and mark the two amounts NOT_COMPARABLE on tax basis.
resolved_errors.resolution: The $0.524bn annual pre-tax expense-benefit illustration is NOT_COMPARABLE with the $3.38bn annual after-tax scale hurdle without an explicit tax conversion; no above/below conclusion is retained.

resolved_errors.concrete_error: The controlling correction establishes a $243.75m annual after-tax hurdle from the FY2026 net-income guidance midpoint, while the earlier materiality section calls a $37.5m annual operating-benefit illustration below the hurdle. The correction withdraws the earlier conflicting hurdle wording but does not tax-align or explicitly withdraw that above/below comparison.
resolved_errors.required_resolution: Explicitly withdraw the below-hurdle assertion and mark the operating-benefit illustration NOT_COMPARABLE with the after-tax hurdle, or convert the illustration to after tax with a labeled assumption.
resolved_errors.resolution: The $37.5m annual pre-tax operating-benefit illustration is NOT_COMPARABLE with the $243.75m annual after-tax guidance hurdle without an explicit tax conversion; no above/below conclusion is retained.

resolution_verification.method: Independent consistency recheck limited to the corrected dossier materiality language and capsule materiality/arithmetic fields; no sources reopened and no broader sweep repeated.

records.verification: Dossier and capsule now label the $0.524bn annual illustration pre-tax and the $3.38bn annual hurdle after-tax, state NOT_COMPARABLE absent a tax conversion, and explicitly withdraw any above/below conclusion.

The main dossier materiality section, controlling correction, and capsule now label the $37.5m annual illustration pre-tax and the $243.75m annual hurdle after-tax, state NOT_COMPARABLE absent tax alignment, and explicitly withdraw the earlier below-hurdle assertion.
